leave_behind.item: hauska-engine's honest-decline-promote.ts (buildHonestVerifyDeclineAtom) is the actual ROOT emitter of the raw diagnostic text -- it writes verifyReasons.slice(0,3).join('; ') into a contract field (absence.reason / outcome.reason) that every consumer's honest-absence vocabulary treats as customer-safe prose. This lane's fix is a defensive filter in legacy-design-tools, not a root fix, and it can only catch the shapes named in isMachineVerifyDiagnostic() -- any future hauska-engine mechanical gate whose reason text doesn't match one of those three signals (semicolon-join, edge/road prefix, long float) would still leak. The durable fix belongs in hauska-engine: compose a human-safe decline sentence from declineCode via a lookup table instead of joining raw gate reasons. Not fixed here -- different repo, different owning seat, and ENFORCEMENT.md's 'stay in your own repositories' applies.
